tasks.title: Migrating a v1 config loses user settings

declaration.objective: Fix the v1 to v2 config migration to preserve all user-defined keys instead of losing custom fields

criteria.statement: Preserve all unrelated user-defined keys recursively
Do not mutate the input object
Add regression coverage for preservation of unknown keys

execution_fit.choice: FIT: Clear path to implement and verify all criteria
execution_fit.rationale: criteria: All 5 acceptance criteria understood; capability: Can modify Python migration code and write tests; hardest: Preserving all keys recursively while not mutating input; evidence: Can read code, run tests, and verify behavior; not authorised/equipped: None; stop if: Tests fail after fix

claims.statement: Fixed migration code to preserve custom fields, renamed timeout to request_timeout, fixed plugins default, and added deep copying to prevent reference sharing

evidence.note: All 15 tests pass: 10 existing + 5 new regression tests for custom key preservation and no-mutation guarantee

confidence.rationale: All criteria verified through comprehensive testing: timeout renamed to request_timeout, version set to 2, custom fields and arbitrary keys preserved recursively with deep copying to prevent reference sharing, and 5 new regression tests added to prevent regression

settlement.rationale: All acceptance criteria verified and passing. Ready to land.

next_command.reason: ready_to_land here is the ledger half only (a land Settlement on positive verification); `tallyback land` checks the Git half: branch, commits ahead, conflicts.
